evidence: Changes time handling and eviction comparison types across src/net_processing.cpp, src/txrequest.cpp, and src/node/eviction.h
rationale: Adopts strongly typed NodeClock::time_point across P2P modules to eliminate type confusion from deprecated GetTime(). This is a clean type-safety improvement that makes peer eviction sorting slightly more precise during same-second ties, but remains an internal refactor without user-visible impact.
